Jonathan Widder | Posted on December 24, 2025 |

Dear readers and friends,

Merry Christmas!

We’re delighted that we were able to bring you another year of solutions-focused news and stories. And once again, a heartfelt thank you for your support: Squirrel News wouldn’t be possible without you!

This summer, our project celebrated its fifth anniversary. If you missed our look back at the first five years, you can catch up on it here.

Over the holidays, we’re slowing things down a bit as well. There’ll be no edition today, but we’ll be back again on Friday.

Warm regards and wishing you a wonderful holiday season,

Jonathan and the entire Squirrel News team

Squirrel News is a non-profit organisation that relies on donations. Please support us now to help us continue our work and keep Squirrel News running!
